configurePresets.name: wasm-dev
configurePresets.description: Local development: the engine carries KoPub and RIDIBatang, so web/ needs no data assets.

configurePresets.name: wasm-production
configurePresets.description: Variant C: the module carries no reader face; packaging ships them as EPD2 data and the worker fetches the default face in parallel with the module. Configured explicitly so a build directory previously set up as dev cannot be deployed as production by accident.

configurePresets.name: wasm-kopub-only
configurePresets.displayName: wasm — variant B (KoPub embedded, RIDIBatang external)
configurePresets.description: A middle rung: keep KoPub embedded (no fetch on the default path) and externalize only the optional face.
